reply:
Happy to help! To add your coworker as an Editor:

1. Go to Settings > Members > Invite
2. Enter their email address
3. Choose the "Editor" role from the dropdown
4. Send the invite

They'll get an email invitation — just note it expires after 7 days, so if they don't accept in time you'll need to resend it. Let me know if you run into any issues!
